habitat: Open woodland, scrub, secondary growth, forest edges, mangroves and cultivated landscapes with scattered trees, gardens and plantations; sea level to 1800 m
description: Small cuckoo, male mainly slate-grey with a white lower belly and undertail and a white wing patch (female often in a dark-barred reddish-brown "hepatic" morph); brood parasite of small warblers such as prinias, tailorbirds and cisticolas; loud plaintive "pee-pip-pee-pee" call.
